Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick update from our side: the product org has just committed the next three sprints to a major analytics migration that pulls engineers off exploratory work. As a result leadership wants to freeze new feature pilots for the quarter.

We need to pause the demo you had on the calendar next week and park the POC conversation for now. Can we put a pin in the demo and circle back in late Q3 or early Q4? I don't want to ghost — we still like Redwood's approach — this is purely an internal reprioritization.

Appreciate your flexibility,
Daniel
Daniel Kim
Head of Platform Engineering | VelocityOps

---
